name: Dental
title: Field Sales Team for Dental Practices | Our Wellness Network
description: Your outsourced field sales team for dental practices in Elmhurst, Lombard and Downers Grove. We visit nearby businesses and build a referral network you can track.
cardBlurb: We visit the daycares, gyms and leasing offices near your practice and get to know their staff.
intro: Our software finds the businesses near your dental practice that see the same families you do. Every month our field team visits them, meets their staff and leaves your printed materials, with permission.
partnersIntro: Families and new neighbors already pass through these places, and the staff there know them.

partners.name: Daycares and preschools
partners.why: Parents of young kids are looking for a dentist the whole family can see.

partners.name: Gyms and fitness studios
partners.why: Their members keep a routine and care about how they look and feel.

partners.name: Apartment leasing offices
partners.why: People who just moved in are looking for a new dentist close to home.

partners.name: Kids' swim and dance schools
partners.why: Parents wait in the lobby every week, and the staff know every family.

partners.name: Hair salons and barbershops
partners.why: Neighbors of every age come through every few weeks and talk with staff they know.

partners.name: Bridal shops
partners.why: Couples planning a wedding are thinking about their smile in every photo.

treatsIntro: On every visit, our field team brings coffee and treats for the whole staff at each partner business, from the front desk to the teachers and coaches. It's simple hospitality, it's the reason staff are glad to see us, and it's included in your plan.
treatExamples: Coffee and muffins for a daycare's opening staff
Snacks and cold drinks for a swim school's after-school instructors
Bagels and coffee for a leasing office's morning team
portalNote: Every sign-up lands in your portal with the business and staff member whose code it came through, so your front desk can call and book, and the call comes from your practice, not from us. Together the sign-ups show which businesses, visits and routes are working.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: Every partner business signs a one-page agreement: mutual promotion, and nobody is paid per referral or per patient.

notes.title: No patient records, ever
notes.text: We never receive patient records, and partners never see who signed up. The sign-up form asks no health questions, and your front desk makes the calls.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We make no medical or health claims and never describe your services in words you haven't approved.

exclusivity: Partners agree to promote one dental practice, yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Which businesses would you visit for my practice?
faq.a: Non-competing businesses near you that see the same families you do, like daycares, kids' swim and dance schools, gyms, salons and leasing offices. Our business matching software ranks them for your practice, you approve the list before any visit, and we skip businesses you already work with unless you ask.

faq.q: What about the rules for healthcare practices?
faq.a: Partner programs for healthcare practices are reviewed for compliance with applicable state rules before launch. We never receive patient records, partners never see who signed up, and the sign-up form asks no health questions. If you'd like your own counsel to review the partner agreement, we'll send it to them.

faq.q: Who calls the people who sign up?
faq.a: Your front desk, from your portal. Each sign-up shows the business and staff member whose code it came through, ready to call. The call comes from your practice, not from us.
